(a) "Partial team history": show a short stack of three schematic 12-region spatial token frames over a horizontal timeline labeled "Round start" to "Current cutoff". Small generic icons and short labels: "Friendly state", "Radar memory", "Footsteps", "Friendly smoke". These are idealized team telemetry, not raw visual video. Beside it a compact tensor stack with label "T x 12 regional tokens". Include "311 input features" as a small factual input label. Every earlier frame is retained. (b) "Structured space-time encoder": show a large exploded block labeled "4 blocks, d = 192, 8 heads". Within ONE block the sequential order must be:
"LN" -> "Spatial attention" with a small distance-matrix icon labeled "Distance bias"
then "LN" -> "Causal temporal attention" with a triangular causal-mask icon
then "LN" -> "Feed-forward".
Show a residual bypass around EACH of these three updates, with little plus circles and small "Learned scale" labels.
Show a small "Evidence gate" node from the input context multiplying ONLY the temporal update before its residual plus. It does not gate the spatial or FFN updates.
At the output split into a neat row of 12 colored region tokens labeled "Final region memory" and a pooled single token labeled "Pooled context". Final region memory is from the last real observed timestep after processing all earlier history. No future frames.

(c) "Region-aligned count decoder": emphasize a coral box "Regional readout" with query/key arrows from the current decoder state and final region memory, and a clearly labeled local-region token. Readout output goes through a little "Scaled residual" plus into the GRU INPUT, not after the output logits. The GRU input also receives three compact embedding nodes labeled "Region", "Previous count", "Remaining count". "Pooled context" initializes the GRU state. Create a FINAL ORIGINAL IEEE journal architecture OVERVIEW, white, wide landscape 2.5:1, high resolution. Panel (a), left 28% width: "Complete team observation history". A tasteful schematic stack of three 12-region frames labelled t-2, t-1, t, with a timeline Round start -> Current cutoff. Panel (b), middle 35% width: "Structured space-time encoder". One pale-blue rounded container labelled "Repeat 4 times · d=192 · 8 heads". Inside this ONE container, show three vertically stacked rounded cards with ONE downward arrow between successive cards:

Panel(c), right 37% width: "Region-aligned count inference". Draw ONE large coral rounded decoder box. This is deliberately an ABSTRACT COMPOSITE MODULE, not a wiring circuit. Inside it print a neat NUMBERED LIST of three stages with NO internal arrows:

calls.prompt:
Edit target: attached detailed CS2 model architecture image. Use case: scientific-educational, precise-object-edit. Produce a corrected high-resolution publication diagram for IEEE Transactions on Games, preserving the supplied detailed three-panel visual style, icons, blue/teal/coral palette, white background, structured circuits, and readable English typography. This should remain a DETAILED architecture diagram, NOT the earlier simplified overview. Aim for a wide image near 2.5:1 with very high resolution and large enough labels for 7.1-inch printed width.

Panel (a) preserve the attractive three observed-grid snapshots and token cube. Heading "Complete team observation prefix". Show Friendly state, Radar memory, Footsteps, Friendly smoke, all earlier sampled frames retained from Round start to Current cutoff, T x 12 region tokens, 311 input features, known hidden count N. Partial observations are retained through the entire sampled round prefix.

Panel (b) retain the detailed pre-norm residual transformer circuit with 4 blocks, d=192, 8 heads. Correct every residual path: x_out = x_in + learned_scale * branch(LN(x_in)). Draw LN -> Spatial attention -> Learned scale -> plus, with an UNSCALED plain identity bypass from branch input to plus. Then LN -> Causal temporal attention -> Evidence gate multiplication -> Learned scale -> plus, with UNSCALED identity bypass. Then LN -> Feed-forward -> Learned scale -> plus, with UNSCALED identity bypass. Distance bias informs spatial attention. Causal mask informs temporal attention. Evidence gate uses observed evidence and multiplies ONLY temporal UPDATE, never identity. Important: put learned scale boxes clearly ON UPDATE OUTPUTS BEFORE THE PLUS, never on identity skips. Under the encoder show final 12-token region memory and a separate pooled context computed from it. These are the only encoder outputs.

Panel (c) redesign wiring cleanly while keeping comparable detail and the regional-attention/GRU/count mechanisms. Heading "Region-aligned count decoder".
Use "Decode regions 1-11; region 12 = remainder" prominently. Never say all 12 regions have a learned step.
- Final region memory (12 tokens) feeds K,V into a coral "Regional readout" attention block.
- Region, previous-count, and remaining-count embeddings sum to e_i. Draw these three small embedding boxes.
- Query label "Q: current state + count context + local region" feeds regional readout. Local region token m_i is part of that query and also the readout local-value residual (short text "attention + local token" inside the readout is sufficient).
- Regional readout OUTPUT -> "Readout scale" -> a plus that adds e_i -> GRU INPUT. The readout must not connect only to query or current state; it must visibly enter the GRU input.
- Pooled context feeds ONLY h_0 initial state of GRU. Current recurrent state h_(i-1) feeds query and GRU state. Never connect pooled context directly to final count output.
- GRU -> Count logits 0...5 -> Remaining-count mask -> Sample count y_i.
- Sample count updates previous count and remaining count for the next region; a single clean bottom feedback arrow is enough.
- Known N initializes remaining count. The final region directly receives the remaining count.
- Joint regional counts output is collected ONLY from sampled regional counts and the last remainder. Use a row of 12 small empty colored cells with "12 integer counts; sum = N"; DO NOT invent numeric counts or show more than five enemies.
- Training footer "Exact NLL + 0.25 conditional RPS" receives dashed arrows from predicted masked probabilities and "Observed counts (training only)". Observed counts have NO arrow into deployed sampling.
Keep arrowheads unambiguous and stop them at block boundaries. Separate state initialization, regional memory readout, sampling, and training paths with ample whitespace, minimal crossings.
No diffusion, no Binomial/prior block, no fake empirical plots or performance numbers, no logos. Preserve the user's preferred detailed illustration appearance.

Precise scientific diagram correction. Edit the supplied detailed architecture. Preserve panel(a), all visual style, icons, colors, and three-panel composition. User reports overlapping/crossing wires near the evidence gate. Redraw panels(b,c) with CLEAN SEPARATE ROWS and fix actual computational wiring. Do not merely move the overlapping line. Keep detailed academic architecture style, as high resolution as possible, generous spacing, large English labels.

Panel(b) replace the cramped horizontal circuit with THREE VERTICALLY STACKED residual rows inside one "Transformer block (x4)" frame. Each row is a simple left-to-right branch:
Row1: input Z -> LN -> Spatial attention -> Scale alpha_S -> ADD -> output U.
Draw a PLAIN UNSCALED identity bypass from Z ABOVE this entire row into ADD. There must be NO scale box on this bypass.
Row2: U -> LN -> Causal temporal attention -> MULTIPLY g(E) -> Scale alpha_T -> ADD -> output V.
Draw a PLAIN UNSCALED identity bypass from U ABOVE this entire row into ADD. Evidence gate sits BELOW this row and feeds only the multiplier with ONE straight vertical arrow.
Row3: V -> LN -> Feed-forward -> Scale alpha_F -> ADD -> output Z+.
Draw a PLAIN UNSCALED identity bypass from V ABOVE this row into ADD. NO scale box on the bypass.
Connect row1 output to row2 input and row2 output to row3 input via the empty outer margin. The row inputs and outputs can be labelled U,V instead of using long crossing connectors.
"Distance bias" mini heatmap points to Spatial attention. "Causal mask" mini heatmap points to Temporal attention. Place "Observed evidence E" as an external small source box, with its own short arrow into Evidence gate; it is NOT the hidden-state wire.
Place enough gap around the gate and multiplier to eliminate overlaps; all arrows terminate at visible boundaries. Spatial and FFN outputs MUST pass THROUGH their Scale box before ADD.
At the bottom show final 12 region-memory tokens and separate mean/max "Pooled context". The outputs come from the final encoder block.

Panel(c) reorganize the decoder to stop illegal pooled-context-to-output wiring. Put "Pooled context" BELOW OR IMMEDIATELY ABOVE THE GRU, with a SHORT direct arrow ONLY to GRU INITIAL STATE h0. Do NOT place pooled context near the final joint-count output. There must be NO pooled-context arrow into that output.
Top: Final region memory M (12 tokens) -> K,V port of Regional readout. Separate query input labelled "Q: h_(i-1) + e_i + m_i". Small local region token m_i contributes to that query and local-value residual inside readout (label "Attention + local token").
Middle: Regional readout OUTPUT -> Readout scale beta -> ADD (other input e_i) -> GRU INPUT.

Bottom-left: small Region / Previous count / Remaining count embedding boxes sum to e_i and feed the ADD. Known N initializes Remaining count. A single feedback loop from Sample updates previous and remaining count.
Far right AFTER Sample: "Joint regional counts (12 integers; sum=N)", with 12 EMPTY colored cells. Only sampled counts and final remainder enter this output. NO other direct arrow into it.
Heading inside decoder: "Learned steps 1-11; region 12 = remainder".
Training footer: "Observed counts (training only)" and predicted MASKED PROBABILITIES feed "Exact NLL + 0.25 conditional RPS" by dashed arrows. No target arrow into sampling. One dashed arrow originates at the masked-probability node, not embedding boxes.
Use short labels and distinct state/input arrows; avoid crossing, colliding, dangling, redundant wires. Preserve full-history cube, 311 features, K12, width192,4blocks,8heads. No empirical measurements, diffusion, Binomial, extra modules or numeric example vector. This must be a correct readable architecture figure for the actual specified computations, not an approximate decorative circuit.

Edit ONLY panel(c) of this figure. Preserve panel(a) and the now clean three-row residual encoder panel(b) exactly. Panel(c) still has two erroneous pooled-context wires: it feeds Regional readout and Joint regional counts. REMOVE BOTH ERRONEOUS WIRES and REMOVE the standalone Pooled context box in panel(c) entirely. Remove every wire originating from it. Do not recreate that box near the output.

All other visual layout, colors, exact constraints, first11steps and lastremainder, 12emptycells, fonts, fullhistory, parameters must stay. No overlaps and no crossings. Final precise connection cleanup. Keep current illustration panels(a),(b),(c) and every corrected residual/decoder module. Do not redesign.
